# Sergio García Mansilla — Portfolio

> Computer Engineer (Universidad Politécnica de Madrid) and Cybersecurity & Systems Technician at Brooktec (Madrid, Spain). Professional Master's in Cybersecurity Management, Ethical Hacking and Offensive Security (EIP International Business School, 2026). Focused on defensive security: systems administration and hardening (Linux/macOS), SIEM (Wazuh), SOC operations, cloud security (AWS, Azure, GCP) and ISO 27001 compliance, with a solid software development background (TypeScript, React Native, Kotlin, Python).

## Highlighted projects

- [wazuh-anomaly-detector](https://github.com/sergarsilla/wazuh-anomaly-detector): real-time unsupervised anomaly detection for the Wazuh SIEM using a PyTorch autoencoder (0.1% measured false-positive rate, validated on production infrastructure). Open source, Apache 2.0. Master's Thesis project.
- [wazuh-llm-triage](https://github.com/sergarsilla/wazuh-llm-triage): SOC level-1 alert triage for Wazuh with a fully local LLM + RAG (Ollama, Qdrant), structured verdicts and bounded active response. Open source, Apache 2.0. Master's Thesis project.
- Cross-platform mobile apps built with React Native/Expo and Firebase, published on Google Play and the App Store.
